checked: the runtime has no timer, process, driver, transport or physical I/O implementation
all active address roles and spans reuse the canonical PLC parser with isolated LB/LW banks
connection-qualified text is rejected before any external-family fallback
typed values are finite and bounded before shifts or conversions; all signed decoding avoids implementation-defined narrowing
both raw words are staged together; BCD and nonfinite float interpretations reject without output mutation
press actions and notices publish candidate bit/word/language/level state only after all checks succeed
duplicate presses and pending input prevent overlapping interaction ownership
release, move-out, cancel, stop and access loss force the owned momentary bit false
input waits for submission; rejected input cannot emit notices and is retained for correction
failed start does not replace the active project or memory; successful start resets banks and retains bounded lifecycle history
startup language follows explicit startupLanguage or the first registered language, never the editor activeLanguage by accident
only logout and language functions run; unsupported timing, predicates, globals, pages and opaque native source are explicit refusals
bound macros are skipped with warnings and macro-skipped events; source bodies never execute
diagnostic events are capped at 512 and text fields are bounded; capabilities errors and macro-name warnings are separately bounded
English function headers, date tags and function-entry declarations retained
remainingLimits: all memory starts at zero, 32-bit storage is low-word-first and access starts at level zero as explicit Lite design choices, not native oracle results
the runtime is a single-thread value owner with one active pointer/input interaction
multiple simultaneous permission predicates, enabled gates with no predicate, nonzero tolerance, nested appearance permissions and timed flash/press behavior are refused
integer fixed-point keypad scaling is refused; float input uses direct finite binary32 values with declared decimal layout limits
unrepresented multi-state lamp values return minus one rather than inventing state zero
raw snapshot LB/LW intentionally exposes test memory; UI/CLI owners must redact password-derived or otherwise sensitive values before exporting diagnostics
root owns UI input retry, output caps/redaction, CMake integration, docs, all physical or native evidence and Git
